question: How reproducible are paired MSE and CWD continuation effects across independently fine-tuned student/teacher pairs and fixed distillation strengths, and how does their interpretation depend on evaluation definition?
rationale: The previous study varied continuation data seeds conditional on one starting pair per phase. This study varies the starting-pair training seed and reports a fixed strength grid without choosing a favorable coefficient. It is a new empirical study, not a novel distillation algorithm or an assurance of publication.

data.provenance: Reconstructed legacy 2018-format mirror, not authenticated official-host Detection 2020 labels. Original labels and completed studies are immutable.

base.endpoint: final epoch 100 EMA last.pt; never validation best.pt
base.independence_scope: Six new BDD fine-tuning runs from fixed official COCO checkpoints, not six independently pretrained COCO models. Independent base training seeds affect head initialization and data/augmentation. Three matched pairs are the unit of replication.

continuation.lr_schedule: cosine over the prespecified 40-epoch trajectory, final multiplier 0.1
continuation.data_seed_rule: pair seed + 1000; identical per-epoch sampler and augmentation across all seven trajectories within a pair
continuation.teacher: corresponding independently fine-tuned large model, frozen and in eval mode
continuation.trainability: all student parameters except DFL projection; fresh 1x1 feature adapters; adapters discarded for inference
continuation.endpoint: final EMA at fixed epochs, no best checkpoint or best coefficient selection
continuation.interpretation: The epoch-20 endpoint is nested in a 40-epoch schedule, not a separately optimized 20-epoch schedule. Equal coefficient values do not imply equal objective or gradient strength. Report all six paired effects and their loss scales.

evaluation.primary: BDD100K ten-class AP50:95 on reconstructed legacy validation labels
evaluation.external: Previously examined KITTI public labeled training partition, 7481 images, Car and Pedestrian; no external score used for coefficient, epoch or model selection. Do not call it a new untouched test or official hidden test.
evaluation.harmonization: Before new external scoring, implement and synthetically verify a common two-class AP evaluator with the same IoU grid and integration rule on BDD and KITTI. Preserve native KITTI scores separately. Document remaining annotation/ignore/sequence differences; harmonization cannot establish a causal domain-shift mechanism.
evaluation.roster: All six base endpoints and all 21 continuation trajectories at epochs 20 and 40; no selective external reporting.

analysis.unit: paired difference within each of the three independently trained starting pairs
analysis.primary_contrasts: Each of the two distillation objectives at each of three coefficients versus its pair-matched no-distillation control at epoch 40
analysis.report: All pair-level scores and differences, mean and sample SD, effect size in percentage points, input hashes, actual AMP-applied/skipped updates, parameter changes, teacher detachment, finite states, runtime and failures
analysis.limits: Three pairs do not characterize a population distribution precisely. No post hoc significance threshold, equivalence claim, favorable-run substitution, pooling with historical runs or winner selection. Reused BDD validation and previously examined KITTI remain disclosed.
analysis.pruning: Historical pruning is contextual only; no new causal pruning comparison or speedup claim from unequal recovery budgets.

execution.preflight: Verify sources and every label hash, full native loader counts, two base seeds on both architectures, updated parameter states, different initial heads/input hashes, and paired control/MSE/CWD smoke inputs including high-strength cases before long jobs.
execution.resume: Technical failures only, identical recorded config and saved RNG/optimizer state; completion and lock files prevent repeats. Completed historical runs are never restarted.
execution.stop: Six 100-epoch base runs plus 21 40-epoch continuations, fixed evaluation roster, numerical audit and manuscript contribution review. Do not extend training to obtain favorable results.
execution.followup: After this fixed stage, additional experiments may be authorized autonomously under the user instruction of 2026-10-18, but only for a documented unresolved question with conditions, budget and stopping rule fixed before execution. Unfavorable outcomes remain reported; no rerunning until favorable, selective suppression, or tuning against KITTI.
